sections.chapter_title: General-purpose and alternate-function I/Os (GPIOs and AFIOs)
sections.text_helper: Section 9.4 "AFIO registers" in chapter 9 (General-purpose and alternate-function I/Os (GPIOs and AFIOs)), RM0008 Rev 21, page 183.
sections.section_content:
Refer to Section2.2 on page 45 for a list of abbreviations used in register descriptions.
Note: To read/write the AFIO_EVCR, AFIO_MAPR and AFIO_EXTICRX registers, the AFIO clock
should first be enabled. Refer to Section7.3.7: APB2 peripheral clock enable register
(RCC_APB2ENR).
The peripheral registers have to be accessed by words (32-bit).
